title: HinterOS catalog index
description: Generated from apps/*.nix by lib.mkIndex (indexVersion 4). Read by the session daemon and the launcher's Store UI. Receivers ignore unknown fields and treat unknown enum values as documented.

kind.description: Entry kind. Apps are installed per profile and shown in the Store; services are box-wide, admin only, and shown in the Server section. Unknown values: ignore the entry.

icon.description: Where the session daemon finds the real icon at runtime; HinterOS ships no logos. siteUrl defaults to homepage.

iconUrl.description: The vendor's own public logo; the daemon downloads and caches it at runtime (https, at most 1 MiB). Optional.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the iconUrl file (hex). Required with iconUrl. The daemon refuses a download with another hash.

boxFeatures.description: Box features the app needs; the system turns them on box-wide when any profile has the app. Always empty for services

starter.description: Installer app step: null (Store only), offered (listed) or ticked (listed and pre-selected; implies onIso). Always null for services

onIso.description: Ships on the ISO, so an offline install can select it. Always false for services

needsServices.description: Ids of kind=service entries this app needs. While one is not installed, show the app with red text (needs the X server; the admin profile can install it in Server) and disable Install. Always empty for services

dataPaths.description: Paths relative to a profile's home that hold the app's data; deleted in the removing profile's home only, when the user removes the app and chooses to delete its data

terms.description: The vendor's full terms, shown before install. null when the app has none

version.description: The vendor's version or revision date; the box records which version was accepted

retrieved.description: When the text was copied from url

file.description: Plain UTF-8 text, relative to this index file

readme.description: The upstream project's README, copied unmodified, shown on the app's Store page. null when there is none

retrieved.description: When the text was copied from url

file.description: Markdown (UTF-8, at most 64 KiB), relative to this index file

unfree.description: The app is not free software. Vendor terms are required; never on the ISO. Missing: true

delivery.description: How the app reaches the box. download: from the binary cache (free apps, and unfree apps that may be redistributed). build: fetched from the vendor and built on the box during install. Unknown values: build

permissions.description: Sandbox permissions the app declares. required: always granted; optional: the profile user can switch it off. Unknown names: ignore. Missing: none

sandbox.description: The session daemon starts the app in its sandbox (all apps except Steam). Always false for services. Missing: true for apps

ports.description: Services: ports the system opens while the service is on. lan: the local networks and tailscale0; any: every source. Empty for apps. Missing: none

setup.description: Services: the setup flow the Server section shows. Unknown values: show only on/off. null for apps and services without setup. Missing: null

stateDirs.description: Services: directories below /var/lib that 'delete server data' removes. Empty for apps. Missing: none

dataPaths.description: As for App: the removed app's data (its sandbox home included), which a profile can still delete. Missing: none
